description: Returns the next events for this seat, oldest first, after `cursor` (omit it to continue from your last ack). Each event names an arrival by id (a text, email, call, or booking change); fetch its detail with read(). Delivery is at-least-once: dedupe on event_id. Pass next_cursor to the next call, and ack it with events_ack once you have processed the page. An error cursor_expired (410) means events behind your cursor were trimmed (7-day retention or backlog cap): resync through read(), then events_subscribe with restart: true.
name: events_list
title: Pull events
